description: This file contains mapping functions for converting watchlist data objects to DTOs, sanitizing entries, and normalizing values based on watchlist type.

methods.name: mapWatchlistToDTO
methods.description: Converts a Watchlist object to a WatchlistEntryDTO, including optional createdBy and updatedBy user info.

methods.name: mapWatchlistListToDTO
methods.description: Maps an array of Watchlist objects to a WatchlistListResponseDTO, with pagination info.

methods.name: mapBlockingResultToDTO
methods.description: Converts a blocking check result object to a BlockingCheckResultDTO.

methods.name: sanitizeWatchlistEntryDTO
methods.description: Sanitizes a WatchlistEntryDTO by hiding email addresses.

methods.name: sanitizeWatchlistValue
methods.description: Normalizes the value based on the watchlist type (email, domain, username).
